summary.text: Celina Villanueva has represented the 12th District in the Illinois Senate since 2020, after serving in the Illinois House from 2019 to 2020.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's biography, Villanueva was born in Chicago and raised in Little Village, and holds a bachelor's degree in Latino/a Studies from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign.
Villanueva formerly worked as Civic & Youth Engagement Manager at the Illinois Coalition for Immigrant and Refugee Rights.
